result.title: MagicGarment: Benchmarking Single-Image Standalone 3D Garment Reconstruction
result.summary: Single-image 3D reconstruction has advanced rapidly, yet standalone garments remain challenging due to thin-shell geometry, open boundaries, and layered structures. Existing datasets and evaluation protocols provide limited support for systematic evaluation in this setting. We introduce MagicGarment, a benchmark for single-image standalone 3D garment reconstruction with 1,518 professionally constructed assets across 17 composite garment types, aligned multimodal annotations, and a unified evaluation protocol. We further establish a garment-aware reference baseline by adapting a pretrained image-to-3D backbone at two levels: Grounded Semantic Refinement (GSR) provides garment-focused visual conditioning, while Flow-Time-Route LoRA (FTR-LoRA) adapts the frozen 3D generative backbone using flow-timestep, token-routing, and expert-load information. Experiments demonstrate MagicGarment's benchmark utility and the effectiveness of garment-aware adaptation. Project page: https://1019538157.github.io/MagicGarment/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MagicGarment：单图独立服装 3D 重建基准，含 1,518 个资产、17 类组合服装、多模态标注与统一评测协议，并以 Grounded Semantic Refinement 和 FTR-LoRA 两种适配方式建立参考基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 属 3D 服装重建的数据集与基准工作，聚焦薄壳几何与网格/生成式建模范式，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策，也无可迁移的 latent reasoning 线索，故排除。
